title: Upload files & documents

body.text: Claude.ai supports uploading many file types directly in the chat window:
PDF, Word, Excel, images (PNG/JPG), and code files
. Click the paperclip icon or drag a file into the message box, and Claude reads and analyzes its contents right away — so you can
ask questions about the file's contents directly

example: "[Upload a lease agreement PDF] Summarize the key terms of this contract, especially the termination clause."

title: Analyzing images with Claude

body.text: Claude has vision capabilities, so it can
analyze images, charts, graphs, and screenshots
. Upload an image and Claude can describe the content, read text in the image, analyze data in a chart, or review a UI design. This is very useful for

example: "[Upload a screenshot of a dashboard] What UX issues does this UI have, and how should I improve it?"
